name: Contract APIv2
description: ##Service Overview The Contract API provides an interface to manage contract resources. Contracts typically originate from source systems, and are stored in Contracts Master and managed via Contract API. Contracts Master stores products for offline product systems (product systems that are not real-time compatible or are non-Suncorp systems, such as NIB). Contract can represent a service, an account, an agreement or a product. For example, Smart Plates contract may be a service contract, a Health Insurance policy is a type of a product. A Contract is usually made up by one or more contract components and has multiple parties associated with it (referred to as Roles in this document). The Contract API is a RESTful interface that enables assisted and self-service applications to rapidly develop functionality centred around the contracts, e.g: create, update, close and retrieve contracts. The complete service catalogue of Customer APIs can be viewed at go/customerapis ##API Usage The Contract API is based on the contract resource. Through the Contract API clients can: - Search and retrieve contracts - Add and update contracts See the Model Schema below for full details on contract attributes. For significant attributes see bellow for more detail. ###Contract Attributes **Id** Contract Id is the unique identifier for a contract in the Contracts Master. This is generated in the Contract Master. **Source** Originating source of a Contract, for example NIB or Smart Plates. **Type** Contract Type determines the type of contract. For example this can be 'Service' or 'Product'. **Reference Id** Reference Id is a unique identifier for the contract in the originating contract source system. **Contract Status** Contract status is determined by the termination date or end date of a contract i.e. - A contract is CLOSED if the contract end date or termination date is today or any earlier date. - Otherwise a contract is OPEN. **Role** A Contract typically has a relationship to one or more Customers, we will refer to a relationship between a Contract and a Customer using the term Role. A Customer is identified by Source System Customer Id (Identifier for a customer in originating source system) and Customer Id (Suncorp Group Brand Customer Identifier, typically GCIS ID, which can be retrieved via Customer API). Each Role has a relationship type (i.e Primary, Secondary, etc), start and end date. There must be at least one open Role on an open contract. **Component** Components represent various parts of a contract, for example a Coverage for an Insurance Product. There must be at least one open component on an open contract. ##Versions There are currently two versions of the Contract API. ###Version 1: Contract API version 1 was created as an offline source system for 'services'. An example of a 'service' is Smart Plates. - Single role contracts. - Single component contracts. ###Version 2: Contract API version 2 was created to act as offline source system for products. Products differ from services as as they have multiple components (e.g. coverages) and multiple roles (e.g. customers). - Ability to handle multiple role contracts. - Ability to handle multiple component contracts. ###Major feature enhancements of V2 - JSON object model has being restructured to reflect business terminology. - Ability to add multiple Roles to a contract. - Ability to add multiple Components to a contract. - Support of contract roles and components maintenance. - Supports extensive contracts search criteria (i.e. sourceSystem, referenceId). Please contact us if you are planning to use this API.
